summary: Top Wealth Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that CEO Kim Kwan Kings Wong resigned effective August 18, 2026, and was redesignated as a non-executive director and Chairman. The board appointed Yuen Cheong Carp Lee as CEO and Deputy Chairman, effective the same date. Lee had been an executive director since February 2026. An employment agreement was entered, with a one-year initial term and automatic renewal. Wong's resignation was not due to disagreements. No price, premium, or deal terms apply. Watch for further board dynamics and strategic direction under new leadership.
